title: Variational Analysis of Metric Projections onto Isotone Projection Cones via Coderivatives
summary: In this paper, we study variational properties of the metric projection mapping onto isotone projection cones in finite-dimensional Euclidean spaces. We derive explicit formulas for both the Fréchet coderivative and the Mordukhovich coderivative of the projection operator. The analysis is based on a local description of the projection mapping via an associated generating system in a neighborhood of a reference point, which leads to computable coderivative characterizations.
